analysis_env_note: All embedding and scoring runs used the deployment-side environment (Python 3.11, numpy/scipy/scikit-learn/opencv-python/onnxruntime-gpu), as stated in supplementary S2; the GPU encoder host is a separate node.
determinism: Every experiment is deterministic given the track tables and embeddings; no model is trained. Bootstrap intervals do not fix a seed, so an AUC interval recomputes to about +/-0.01.
code_version: no VCS checkout on the analysis machine; files are identified by sha256 in MANIFEST.csv instead of a commit hash.
